description: Source code for Bluetooth Hands Free Profile (HFP) handling on the handsfree side, including connection management, AT command processing, and indicator handling.

methods.name: hf_slc_error
methods.description: Handles SLC (Service Level Connection) errors by disconnecting the RFCOMM DLC.

methods.name: hfp_hf_send_cmd
methods.description: Sends an AT command over RFCOMM with callback handling.

methods.name: cind_handle_values
methods.description: Handles individual CIND indicator values and updates internal indicator table.

methods.name: ag_indicator_handle_values
methods.description: Handles AG indicator values and triggers corresponding callbacks.

methods.name: unsolicited_cb
methods.description: Dispatches unsolicited responses to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: cmee_finish
methods.description: Handles the finish of +CME ERROR responses.

methods.name: cind_status_finish
methods.description: Handles the finish of CIND status command.

methods.name: cind_finish
methods.description: Handles the finish of CIND query.

methods.name: brsf_finish
methods.description: Handles the finish of BRSF command.

methods.name: hf_slc_establish
methods.description: Initiates SLC establishment by sending AT+BRSF.

methods.name: bt_hfp_hf_lookup_bt_conn
methods.description: Finds the HFP handler associated with a Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_hfp_hf_send_cmd
methods.description: Sends specific AT commands (ATA, CHUP) over a Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_hfp_hf_accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming RFCOMM connections and initializes handler state.

methods.name: bt_hfp_hf_register
methods.description: Registers the HFP callback structure and initializes the profile.
